01 / The loop

State creates possibility.

Nemeia does not begin with a list of commands. It begins with what exists right now. Components describe the world; action requirements match against those components; affordances are the result.

01 · Sense

Observations arrive

Sensors, simulators, or operators provide evidence about what is present and how it is changing.

observation →
02 · Compose

Entities get meaning

A stable identity is given a component map: connection, transform, portable, observable, and more.

entity + components
03 · Relate

Facts connect things

Directed relationships such as located_in, observes, or supports stay first-class.

subject → predicate → object
04 · Derive

Possibilities emerge

Actions declare the actor and target components they need. The runtime derives available affordances from current state.

requirements → affordance
05 · Act

A meaningful change runs

An action can update components, create relationships, return a result, and emit domain events.

action.perform()
06 · Record

The world moves forward

Events are ordered, snapshots are deterministic, and the next interaction set is derived from the new state.

events → repeat
02 / Core abstractions

Small primitives. Composable worlds.

The World Runtime keeps the ontology deliberately small. Each abstraction has one job, which makes the same model usable for a robot, a game character, a room, a camera, or a simulated object.

W · 01

World

The current collection of entities, relationships, actions, and events.

world.snapshot()
E · 02

Entity

A stable identity for one thing. The entity itself is intentionally light; its components carry meaning.

id · label · type · components
C · 03

Component

Composable state or ability attached to an entity: locomotion, power, vision, transform, or portable.

entity.components[name]
R · 04

Relationship

A directed fact connecting two entities, with optional metadata and provenance.

subject — predicate — object
F · 05

Affordance

An action currently available to an actor and optional target, including a reason when it is not available.

affordancesFor(actor, target)
A · 06

Action

A meaningful operation that declares requirements and applies effects, relationships, results, and events.

registerAction() · execute()
S · 07

System

A continuous process that senses, updates state, executes actions, or emits events.

sense · update · execute
V · 08

Event

An ordered record of a world change. Events make the transition visible and replayable.

seq · timestamp · type · data
03 / Architecture

One world model. Two execution planes.

The active path makes the world legible to an operator and an agent. The retained governance suite adds authorization and control-plane guarantees when a deployment needs them.

Retained · Governance extension

implemented reference suite · optional to the active core

Mission APITransport-neutral requests for missions, runs, robots, scene, events, anomalies, and replay.
Mission ServerPolicy, approvals, registry state, signed Authorizations, and the Event Log.
Supervisor KernelVerifies Authorizations, owns stop state, clamps ticks, and watches heartbeats.
Driver / Capability HostHardware boundary and sandboxed executors with declared limits.

Cross-cutting projections: Scene · Attention · Replay · Reports read from the Event Log. The suite is preserved as an optional governance path, not a prerequisite for World Runtime.

04 / Scene model

Evidence is not identity.

Nemeia keeps physical geometry and semantic meaning separate. An observation can update an entity; it is not the entity. A body can support several semantic interpretations while perception is uncertain.

Physical layer

Answers geometry, motion, contact, clearance, and simulation questions.

Worldcoherent physical snapshot
Bodypose, velocity, motion type
Shapecollision or sensor geometry
Geometrybox, capsule, mesh, point cloud
Materialfriction, density, restitution
Filtercollision categories and masks
Contacttouching, normal, impulse
Sensorkeepout, frustum, interest region

Semantic layer

Answers identity, meaning, provenance, confidence, freshness, and task relevance.

Entitystable semantic identity
Observationevidence from a source
Relationexplicit semantic fact
Affordancemeaningful possibility
Provenancewhy the system believes it
Confidencehow certain the belief is
Freshnesswhen the evidence was current
Task memorymission-specific context
Key boundary: raw camera frames, masks, point clouds, and detector invocations are evidence. The agent should usually receive the compact Scene projection: entities, hazards, free-space summaries, object tracks, and confidence/freshness metadata.

06 / Current state

The loop is real. The world is still gaining meaning.

The first World Runtime slice is implemented and wired to the live Go2 operator surface. The next slice is semantic perception: turn sensor evidence into additional entities and relationships, then bind physical action packs to the same actions used in simulation.
